Ref. SOP-07 Rev 8 1 March 2021
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE - SOP-07 Solvent cleaning of dispersers and
mixing vessels
Document: SOP-07 Solvent cleaning of dispersers and mixing vessels
Revision: Rev 8 (current), effective 01/03/2021.
Batch size: per cleaning. Equipment: D-1..D-4, T-1..T-6, solvent station.
Steps
1. Drain residual product into the recovery drum.
2. Bond and earth the vessel and the solvent drum before any solvent transfer.
3. First rinse: circulate 40 L acetone (RM-301) for 10 min; drain to waste solvent.
4. Second rinse with 20 L fresh acetone (RM-301); drain to waste solvent.
5. Wipe agitator shaft and blades with a xylene-soaked rag (approx. 1 L xylene, RM-305).
6. Before any vessel entry: force-ventilate 15 min and check O₂ and LEL with the gas
detector.
7. Leave the vessel lid open overnight after cleaning.
8. Wait at least 60 min after cleaning before charging the next batch.
9. Record the cleaning in the vessel logbook and sign.
Controlled copy - the MES recipe is the master.
